privacyDraft: Draft privacy notice — pending legal review
privacyBody: SnapMatch is being developed to help guests find their photos within a single event. Before camera access, guests will be asked for consent. Selfies will be processed in memory for matching and will not be saved. Event face data will expire on the date shown for that event. Photos will be private, and guests will receive access only to their matched photos. A removal option will be provided. Contact details, retention rules, legal basis and processor information must be completed before launch.

faqs.a: Photographers can create events, upload photos and download QR posters. Guest face search and photo delivery are coming soon.
Weddings, birthdays, corporate events, concerts, graduations and family gatherings. Photographers can keep each event in its own gallery.
No guest account is planned. Guests will open their event link, give consent and take a selfie.
Search is designed to use the selfie temporarily and discard it. Event face data has a separate expiry date. See the privacy notice for details.
Azerbaijani, Russian and English. Photographers choose the languages for each event.
